SELECT stock.bill_no, (SELECT MAX(picking.task_code) FROM mes_warehouse_picking_bill picking WHERE picking.bill_no = stock.bill_no AND picking.factory_code = stock.factory_code AND picking.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM stock.tenant_id AND picking.del_flag = '0') AS task_code, stock.mat_code, stock.reservation_no, stock.requirement_mat_code, MAX(stock.requirement_mat_name) AS requirement_mat_name, MAX(stock.substitute_flag) AS substitute_flag, MAX(stock.substitute_ratio) AS substitute_ratio, MAX(stock.mat_name) AS mat_name, MAX(stock.mat_spec) AS mat_spec, MAX(stock.mat_unit) AS mat_unit, stock.mat_batch, MAX(stock.supplier_code) AS supplier_code, MAX(stock.supplier_name) AS supplier_name, stock.warehouse_code, MAX(stock.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, stock.site_code, MAX(stock.site_name) AS site_name, SUM(stock.num) AS num, MAX(stock.judge_status) AS judge_status, MAX(stock.factory_code) AS factory_code FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock stock
stock.mat_detail_type = 'RAW' AND stock.del_flag = '0' AND stock.factory_code = #{query.factoryCode}
AND stock.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.billNo}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_warehouse_picking_bill picking WHERE picking.bill_no = stock.bill_no AND picking.factory_code = stock.factory_code AND picking.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM stock.tenant_id AND picking.task_code = #{query.taskCode} AND picking.del_flag = '0' )
AND stock.mat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matName}, '%')
AND stock.mat_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matCode}, '%')
AND stock.mat_spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matSpec}, '%')
AND stock.mat_batch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matBatch}, '%')
AND stock.site_code = #{query.siteCode}
GROUP BY stock.bill_no, stock.factory_code, stock.tenant_id, stock.mat_code, stock.reservation_no, stock.requirement_mat_code, stock.warehouse_code, stock.site_code, stock.mat_batch HAVING SUM(stock.num) > 0
